FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF RUSSIAN, PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
Ref. No.D-RUS/23/298 Dated: 31.10.2023
Walk-in Interview
The walk-in-Interview for appointing Guest Faculty (Russian Language & Literature) for the academic session
2023-2024 will be held on 14th November (Tuesday), 2023 at 2.00 p.m. in the office of the Chairperson,
Department of Russian, Panjab University, Chandigarh as per the schedule given below:
Date: 14.11.2023 Subject Specialization
required
No. of Posts Time
Verification of original
documents
Russian Language & Literature 01 11.00 am to 1.00 p.m.
Interview Russian Language & Literature 01 2.00 p.m. onwards
Important Note: The applications for Guest Faculty (Russian Language & Literature) for the
academic session 2023-2024 will be submitted online at email russian@pu.ac.in
before 10th November 2023 by duly filling the form available on the link
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf
and bring the hardcopy of application along with the original documents for
verification at the time of interview.
Asstt. Professor: (01) Russian (Guest faculty)
Essential: As per UGC & P.U. Guidelines, in addition M.A in Russian is must.
(i) Besides fulfilling the above qualification, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility
Test (NET) conducted by UGC or must fulfil the other UGC regulations for recruitment and
appoint of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in the University/College/Institute.
(ii) Good Academic record as defined by concerned University with at least 55% marks (50% marks
in case of SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent grade in
Masters degree level.
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs.1500/- per lecture with an upper
limit of Rs.50000/- per month. You are advised to contact on mobile 9872204270 (Prof. Pankaj Malviya),
7986477286 (Mr. Mahesh Prasad) for any further update, before coming for the interview.
Sd/-
Chairperson
Department of Russian
